Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report, subsequently in the statement of the victim recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that they married at Arya Samaj Temple.
The victim refused to undergo medical examination.
The tentative age of the victim is around 17 years.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

opennyai_summary.decision:
4. Considering the two statements not supporting the prosecution story, the applicant who is in custody since 30.05.2024 and has no criminal history is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
5. Let the applicant Saurabh Gupta be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 97 of 2024, under Sections 363, 336-A, 376 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Dhanpatganj, District Sultanpur, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
